metadata.title: Retro Rock Portrait with Graphic Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central subject against a vibrant red gradient, utilizing a distinct monogram-based typographic layout in the upper right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male subject with 1970s-80s shaggy hair, positioned centrally against a deep red background that transitions to black at the edges. The foreground features a stylized interaction with legs in high-heeled sandals, while the upper right corner is occupied by a multi-layered typographic lockup including a large monogram and secondary sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with direct eye contact
Typography anchored to the top-right corner
Foreground elements creating a horizontal visual break
Warm studio lighting highlighting hair texture
coreInvariants: Deep red to black radial gradient background
High-contrast rim lighting on the hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the central 60% of the frame, medium shot from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white monogram in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes to the monogram, then down through the foreground limbs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and lower right corners to balance the text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with deep shadows in the subject's clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Secondary text uses wide tracking and thin strokes
Horizontal rule line bisects the monogram
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' and 'M' are vertically stacked and interlocking
Horizontal bar extends from the center of the monogram across the width of the secondary name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale contrast between a heavy monogram and light, airy secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight of the monogram
Provides the correct 70s/80s geometric feel for the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a 1980s shaggy haircut wearing a black turtleneck, set against a deep red radial gradient background that fades to black at the edges. Include a foreground element of crossed legs in gold strappy heels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a typographic lockup in the top right corner. Create a large cream-colored 'FM' monogram with a horizontal line cutting through the middle. Place the artist name in a thin, wide-tracked sans-serif font to the right of the monogram, and a blue subtitle below.

verificationChecks: Is the monogram the largest typographic element?
Does the background have a visible red-to-black gradient?
Is the secondary text tracking sufficiently wide?
Is the lighting high-contrast on the subject's hair?

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic alignment with the horizontal rule
Ensure the red background doesn't wash out skin tones
Verify the monogram is cream/off-white, not pure white
Confirm the 80s studio lighting aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Red Gradient + Geometric Monogram Lockup
